entities.summary: Trey Anthony Lyles is a Canadian-American professional basketball player for Real Madrid of the Liga ACB and the EuroLeague. He was drafted by the Utah Jazz following his freshman season at the University of Kentucky. He has also played in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for the Denver Nuggets, San Antonio Spurs, Detroit Pistons, and Sacramento Kings.
